confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable; accommodation is less certain, and July is peak season in Hoi An, so room rates may run high. The FX value comes from a garbled search snippet attributed to the rba.gov.au homepage, not from a verified read of the F11.1 table, so confirm it against the official table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general Vietnamese price levels for tourist-oriented central cities such as Da Nang and Hue, adjusted upward for Hoi An's heritage-town tourist demand and July peak-season accommodation pricing. Drink anchors were set from the local beer price, since wine and cocktail prices are less certain.
